milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia wall sign is at spawn-relative (-9, 3, -6) on the south face of the acacia building. Player must navigate north from spawn courtyard (~9 blocks away, behind courtyard walls) and face the sign. Max_distance=5 ensures actual proximity to the south entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia stairs are inside the acacia building along the west wall, middle stair at (-11, 2, -10). Max_distance=5 requires the player to be inside the building looking at the staircase.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_log with the wooden axe drops the item into the player's inventory. The player mines acacia logs from the east wall (x=-6) of the acacia structure to breach into the enclosed zone. At least 1 acacia_log must appear in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The granite stairs are on the upper level (y=5) of the acacia building at (-7, 5, -9). Player must climb the interior acacia stairs to reach the upper level. Max_distance=5 requires being on the upper level near the east wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task for a visual landmark. The lavafall is visible through the east window of the acacia building's upper level. Target is the east window opening at (-6, 5, -9) where the lava in the chimney becomes visible. Player must be on the upper level (near granite stairs) and face east toward the window/chimney. Max_distance=5 ensures they are on the upper level; facing_tolerance=60 ensures they look east toward the lavafall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak button is on the west exterior wall of the elevated oak structure at (4, 3, -11). Player must breach the acacia east wall, cross the open zone, climb external stairs, and face the button. Max_distance=5 requires being at the oak structure's west face near the entrance.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak_slab drops the item into the player's inventory. The oak slabs form the sealed floor at y=2 (type=top) inside the oak structure. Player mines them with the wooden pickaxe to create a hole to drop into the sealed basement below where the bed is. At least 1 oak_slab must appear in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_fence_gate with the wooden axe drops the item into the player's inventory. The birch fence gate is at (8, 3, -9) inside the oak structure's upper room, reachable from the oak slab floor surface at y=2.5. At least 1 birch_fence_gate must appear in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops the item into the player's inventory. The light blue bed is in the sealed basement at (8, 1, -9)/(8, 1, -10), accessible only after mining through the oak slab floor at y=2 above. Beds break instantly by hand. At least 1 light_blue_bed must appear in inventory.
